g.text: duplex outlet: PE, LIGHT, N, MOTOR

g.desc: duplex outlet: PE, LIGHT, N, MOTOR

g.text: ISOLATION BARRIER: U3, K1, U2 and PS1 straddle it; keep at least 6 mm creepage across it

g.desc: ISOLATION BARRIER: U3, K1, U2 and PS1 straddle it; keep at least 6 mm creepage across it

g.text: HAND-WHEEL ENCODER (two Hall latches, quadrature; same cable as the index)

g.desc: HAND-WHEEL ENCODER (two Hall latches, quadrature; same cable as the index)

g.text: MAINS IN, FUSE, SURGE; OUTLET (LIGHT always on, MOTOR controlled)

g.desc: MAINS IN, FUSE, SURGE; OUTLET (LIGHT always on, MOTOR controlled)

g.text: TRIAC STAGE (after AN1662: triac in series with the motor)

g.desc: TRIAC STAGE (after AN1662: triac in series with the motor)

g.text: 8. Encoder U5/U6 (ring of alternating magnets) optional: stops taught and landed by angle; 5-wire cable (3V3, GND, index, A, B).

g.desc: 8. Encoder U5/U6 (ring of alternating magnets) optional: stops taught and landed by angle; 5-wire cable (3V3, GND, index, A, B).

g.text: 7. Heel: momentary switch to GND in either pedal (J5 pin 4, J6 pin 3); a heel tap sends the needle to its other stop.

g.desc: 7. Heel: momentary switch to GND in either pedal (J5 pin 4, J6 pin 3); a heel tap sends the needle to its other stop.

g.text: 6. On a WeAct RP2350B Core board, feed PS1 to the 5V pin: the board has its own diode from USB VBUS, so D2 may be left out.

g.desc: 6. On a WeAct RP2350B Core board, feed PS1 to the 5V pin: the board has its own diode from USB VBUS, so D2 may be left out.

g.text: 5. R7/R8: ~3.9 mA peak in the H11AA1; R11: ~8 mA into U3 from 3.3 V; R6/C2 fitted only if a snubberless triac false-fires.

g.desc: 5. R7/R8: ~3.9 mA peak in the H11AA1; R11: ~8 mA into U3 from 3.3 V; R6/C2 fitted only if a snubberless triac false-fires.

g.text: 1. After Freescale AN1662: zero-cross interrupt sets a timer alarm (or a PIO program); at the firing delay a ~100 us gate pulse fires the

g.desc: 1. After Freescale AN1662: zero-cross interrupt sets a timer alarm (or a PIO program); at the firing delay a ~100 us gate pulse fires the

g.text: 2. Pins (RP2350B): FIRE GP4; RELAY GP5; ZC GP6; HALL (index) GP7; ENC_A/B GP2/GP3 (PIO counter); STITCH GP10; HEEL GP11; NEEDLE GP12;

g.desc: 2. Pins (RP2350B): FIRE GP4; RELAY GP5; ZC GP6; HALL (index) GP7; ENC_A/B GP2/GP3 (PIO counter); STITCH GP10; HEEL GP11; NEEDLE GP12;

g.text: knee, pedal, FSR, limit on ADC0-3 (GP40-43); ADC4-7 spare; GP8/GP9 UART1 for debug (or USB serial). Avoid GP0, GP23, GP25 (PSRAM, key, LED).

g.desc: knee, pedal, FSR, limit on ADC0-3 (GP40-43); ADC4-7 spare; GP8/GP9 UART1 for debug (or USB serial). Avoid GP0, GP23, GP25 (PSRAM, key, LED).

g.text: 3. PS1 feeds VSYS through D2, so USB may stay plugged in (the control side is SELV). Flash by UF2 (BOOTSEL) or SWD. Drive GP4 at 8-12 mA.

g.desc: 3. PS1 feeds VSYS through D2, so USB may stay plugged in (the control side is SELV). Flash by UF2 (BOOTSEL) or SWD. Drive GP4 at 8-12 mA.

g.text: 4. Fire only after a zero-cross has been seen and the command is zero; close K1 last and open it first. Never scope the line side.

g.desc: 4. Fire only after a zero-cross has been seen and the command is zero; close K1 last and open it first. Never scope the line side.

g.text: NOTES. A concept drawn by Claude at Bob Drzyzgula's direction, October 2026: not built, not tested, values not checked.

g.desc: NOTES. A concept drawn by Claude at Bob Drzyzgula's direction, October 2026: not built, not tested, values not checked.

g.text: triac; hand-wheel period from edge timestamps; speed loop every half-cycle (120 Hz); stall watchdog. Added: isolation, relay, inputs.

g.desc: triac; hand-wheel period from edge timestamps; speed loop every half-cycle (120 Hz); stall watchdog. Added: isolation, relay, inputs.
